text:
Nadia R: Heads up 1: we received a dispute from Globex for invoice GLOBEX-2026-98 for $9,750. Stripe dispute id dp_1Kp3Z2. Reason: 'product_not_received' but billing notes say 'API usage'. We have 5 days to submit evidence. @Ibrahim please advise.
Tom W: Can we confirm billing_project and which API key was charged? Also need last4 and cardholder email.
Nadia R: Billing notes show project globex-infra-prod, card last4 1111, email billing@globex.example. Billed period 2026-06-10..2026-06-20.
Ibrahim (Payments): I'll need the daily token usage, refund history, and whether the account had a billing contact on file. Also check for prior chargebacks or risk flags.
Jordan (CS): The customer says "we didn't receive the expected throughput; our app didn't see responses." Their test env shows 500ms latency but they expected <200ms. Could be a latency complaint, not fraud.
Chargeback-Bot: dispute.created id=dp_1Kp3Z2 amount=9750 currency=USD reason=product_not_received created=1714312300
Tom W: Ok, let's pull the usage for the period and request logs. Also need the console deploy history to see if they changed model to cheaper variant mid-month.
Ibrahim (Payments): We have a prior small dispute from same account in 2025 Q4 flagged as 'fraud_chargeback'. Score: low. No automatic fraud block triggered.
Nadia R: Jordan, any support tickets about degraded service?
Jordan (CS): Two tickets: TKT-4558 (latency) opened 2026-06-12, TKT-4601 (billing question) opened 2026-06-18. Both have replies. I've included the ticket transcripts in the Stripe reply draft.
Tom W: From logs: usage is present. However, a large batch of requests on 2026-06-15 show a sharp spike but 53% of responses returned 503 due to a model failover. That could explain perceived 'not received'.
Ibrahim (Payments): For Stripe evidence we should provide: invoice, request logs with response codes, status pages during period, and support ticket threads. Also note any credits applied.
Nadia R: Any refunds applied?
Jordan (CS): We issued a goodwill credit of $1,000 on 2026-06-19 for the outage. Not a full refund.
Tom W: Also find deploy logs: there was a canary on 2026-06-15 that replaced rdx-14b with rdx-14b-quant for cost testing. Canary caused higher 503 rate in that build.
Ibrahim (Payments): Include the canary PR link in the bundle and note that the customer was notified in the status page. Provide timestamps of status page incident: 2026-06-15 04:20..08:10 UTC.
Chargeback-Bot: dispute.updated id=dp_1Kp3Z2 status=needs_response by=merchant deadline=1714365900
Nadia R: I'll draft a response: explain that service was delivered but degraded during a partial outage, include support ticket, credit given, and show they still received X tokens. Will propose that dispute be closed without refund.
Ibrahim (Payments): Also check if any of the usage matches test keys or low-volume sandbox projects. If customer claims they didn't receive service, but tokens were consumed by test keys, argue usage belonged to production keys.
Jordan (CS): Customer says their telemetry shows zero inbound on 2026-06-15 04:00..06:00 UTC; our logs show 503 responses, so client didn't process payloads. We should note retries and downstream error handling.
Tom W: Uploaded request log snippet to ticket: https://support.example/tickets/TKT-4753/attachment/globex_logs_jun.csv. Shows 503s with error 'model_unavailable' and retry attempts with same request_id when client retried.
Nadia R: Timeline: 06-15 04:15 deploy canary, 04:22 errors spike, 04:40 incident posted, 08:10 incident resolved, 06-19 $1k credit issued.
Ibrahim (Payments): I'll assemble the evidence bundle and submit via Stripe API. If Stripe rules for Globex, we absorb chargeback fee. If they rule for customer, we'll need to consider goodwill refund given the outage.
Jordan (CS): Customer requested expedited response. They also asked to temporarily pause invoicing until dispute resolved.
Nadia R: Put invoice on hold (billing_hold=true) and mark in billing notes. Also flag account for a follow-up QBR.
Ibrahim (Payments): Submitting evidence now. Attached: invoice PDF, request logs, support tickets, status page screenshot, credit note, canary PR link.
Chargeback-Bot: dispute.submitted id=dp_1Kp3Z2 submitted_by=Ibrahim result=pending
Tom W: Noted. If Stripe comes back in favor of the customer, prepare refund and escalate to finance for chargeback fee reimbursement tracking.
Nadia R: Thanks team. Keep updates in ticket TKT-4753.
